info.name: Get average peer scores for operators in a cluster

params.name: lockHash
params.description: The `lock_hash` calculated for a cluster lock.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date for the range (ISO 8601 format). If not provided, defaults to endDate - 7 days.

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for the range (ISO 8601 format). If not provided, defaults to the latest available date.

items.docs: This endpoint returns the average peer_score for each operator address in a cluster lock within a specified date range. Results are sorted by peer_score in descending order.
